CNN live blog, 25 July 2026: "Live updates: US-Iran war; Trump says he doesn't 'think it's time yet' for deal."

At the White House Correspondents' Association Dinner (24-25 July 2026), President Trump on a possible deal with Iran:
- "I don't think it's time yet. But I'm willing to listen."
- "I don't think they're ready to" [make a deal]
- Acknowledged Iran is talking to the US and would "love to make a deal."

US Central Command completed its 13th consecutive night of strikes on Iran. Trump has threatened to strike bridges and power plants for every vessel Iran attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has retaliated daily against US assets in the region, killing three US soldiers in a strike on a base in Jordan last week.
